newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu cancels visit to the Netherlands.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu cancels visit to the Netherlands.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has cancelled a February 12 visit to the Netherlands in the aftermath of the air disaster in which 73 Israeli soldiers died, his office said on Thursday.

"The prime minister spoke today with the Dutch prime minister and explained to him that the visit...would have taken place during memorial ceremonies for some of the victims and therefore he will visit at another date," it said.
"The Dutch prime minister said he understood the reasons for the cancellation and expressed his condolences to the Israeli people," the statement said.
Netanyahu had been due to stop off in the Netherlands, which holds the European Union presidency, early on Wednesday on his way to talks in Washington on Thursday with U.S. President Bill Clinton.
Instead, Netanyahu will leave later on Wednesday and travel directly to the United States.
